units.source_text: 烟雾从我背后逼将过来。

en.t: Smoke pressed in from behind me.

units.source_text: 我一阵咳嗽，看了看誉称惠心①之作的观音像和仙女奏乐藻并图案。

en.t: I coughed for a while, then looked at the statue of Kannon said to be the work of Eshin, and at the coffered ceiling design showing heavenly maidens playing music.

units.source_text: 弥漫潮音洞的烟雾愈发浓重了。

en.t: The smoke filling the Choon-do grew thicker and heavier.

units.source_text: 我再上了一层楼，准备打开究竟顶的门。

en.t: I went up one more floor and prepared to open the door to the Kukkyoucho.
